objects.constraint public.audit_events.audit_act: CHECK ((((actor_type = ANY (ARRAY['anonymous'::text, 'external_api_key'::text, 'external_oauth_client'::text, 'external_user'::text])) AND (actor_id IS NULL)) OR ((actor_type <> ALL (ARRAY['anonymous'::text, 'external_api_key'::text, 'external_oauth_client'::text, 'external_user'::text])) AND (actor_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(actor_id) >= 1) AND (length(actor_id) <= 256)))))
objects.constraint public.audit_events.audit_cre: CHECK ((((credential_type = 'none'::text) AND (credential_id IS NULL) AND (credential_scope IS NULL) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL) AND (oauth_grant_id IS NULL)) OR ((credential_type = 'session'::text) AND (credential_scope IS NULL) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL) AND (oauth_grant_id IS NULL)) OR ((credential_type = 'api_key'::text) AND (credential_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((credential_scope IS NULL) OR (credential_scope = ANY (ARRAY['read'::text, 'bookings'::text, 'full'::text]))) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL) AND (oauth_grant_id IS NULL)) OR ((credential_type = 'oauth'::text) AND (credential_id IS NULL) AND (credential_scope IS NULL) AND (oauth_client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (oauth_grant_id IS NOT NULL))))
objects.constraint public.audit_events.audit_eve:
CHECK (
CASE action
    WHEN 'booking.bulk_cancellation_admitted'::text THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text) THEN (((details - 'selectedCount'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((details -> 'selectedCount'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((details ->> 'selectedCount'::text) ~ '^([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-5])$'::text)), false))
        ELSE false
    END
    WHEN 'booking.bulk_cancellation_completed'::text THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text) THEN (((details - 'counts'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND COALESCE(team_booking_bulk_audit_counts_valid((details -> 'counts'::text)), false))
        ELSE false
    END
    ELSE audit_event_pre_bulk_details_valid(audit_events.*)
END)
objects.index public.audit_events.audit_events_o: CREATE INDEX audit_events_organization_action ON public.audit_events USING btree (organization_id, action, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX audit_events_organization_actor ON public.audit_events USING btree (organization_id, actor_type, actor_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX audit_events_organization_time ON public.audit_events USING btree (organization_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
